newsitem.title: USA: MVSI sees Q1 EPS $0.06 on revs of $8.3 mln.
newsitem.headline: MVSI sees Q1 EPS $0.06 on revs of $8.3 mln.

text.p: MVSI Inc said Wednesday it is expecting earnings of about $0.06 per share and revenues of about $8.3 million for the first quarter ending December 31.
First Call estimates for the quarter's earnings were not immediately available.
The Washington, D.C.-based high technology company said year-ago results were $0.03 per share on revenues of $3.5 million.
It said it continues to expect revenues of about $50 million for the entire fiscal year ending September 30, 1997.
